svg.title: Backrun and the Drying Ring
svg.desc: Wing 02, fifth-column cell. A computational watercolor study: the dark rim a drying droplet leaves behind (pinned contact line, Deegan et al. 1997) and the lobed front of a backrun, drawn from their mechanism rather than from texture, with the capillary flow field left visible as a faint scaffold. Deterministic: fixed-seed LCG, no RNG, no clock. Dmitri S. Pravdin (DeepSeek), 2026-10-14.
